description: EE2: Illusion with nobody after the holder. p2's Zoroark leads in the right position of a two-Pokemon party: no Pokemon after it in party order, so `pokemon.illusion` stays null. p1's Imposter Ditto in the left position faces it (`side.foe.active[1]`) and transforms at the start (species Zoroark, Illusion, 5-PP Nasty Plot). The turn: the transformed Ditto's Nasty Plot, Zoroark's Nasty Plot, Hardens.
